banner.title: Siyawuhlonipha ubumfihlo bakho
banner.text: Sisebenzisa ii-cookie neetekhnoloji ezifanayo. Ii-cookie ezifunekayo zigcina iwebhusayithi isebenza. Ngemvume yakho, sisebenzisa nee-cookie zokukhetha zeempawu, uhlalutyo nentengiso. Unokwamkela zonke, ukwala zonke, okanye ukhethe ngodidi ngalunye, kwaye utshintshe uluvo lwakho nangaliphi na ixesha.

preferences.title: Okukhethwayo kwee-cookie
preferences.text: Khetha ezo ndidi zokukhetha uzivumelayo. Ii-cookie ezifunekayo azinakucinywa kuba iwebhusayithi ayisebenzi ngaphandle kwazo.

necessary.title: Ezifunekayo
necessary.description: Ziyafuneka kwimisebenzi esisiseko efana nokhuseleko, ukulinganisa umthwalo nokukhumbula olu khetho lwemvume.

functional.title: Ezisebenzayo
functional.description: Zikhumbula izinto ozikhethayo ezifana nolwimi okanye ummandla kwaye zenza ukuba iimpawu ezifakelweyo zisebenze.

analytics.title: Uhlalutyo
analytics.description: Zisinceda siqonde indlela iwebhusayithi esetyenziswa ngayo ukuze siyiphucule.

marketing.title: Intengiso
marketing.description: Zisetyenziselwa ukulinganisa nokwenza izibhengezo zibe ngezomntu ngamnye kumawebhusayithi ahlukeneyo.
